text: I am sorry to bother you at this hour. My grandson is 10. He has some spots on his legs that I pressed a glass on and they did not fade. His skin is dark so it is hard to see colour, but his palms and the bottoms of his feet look very pale and sort of greyish to me, and inside his lip looks paler than usual. Forgive me if this is nothing, I did not know who else to ask.
